Frequently Asked Questions

We look for licensed, insured waste hauling companies with reliable equipment and a track record of professional service. You'll need valid business insurance, proper licensing for your service area, and the capacity to handle commercial-scale jobs.

Once your application is approved and onboarding is complete, you can start receiving job alerts within 48 hours. The onboarding process typically takes 3-5 business days depending on documentation review.

We offer transparent, reliable payment terms. Invoices are processed bi-weekly with direct deposit. You'll have full visibility into all completed jobs and payments through our vendor portal.
